findings: The source 142-face boundary remains collision-free in all tested poses and frames.
Lowering the threshold from 1.38850 m to 1.38842 m adds two donor faces and remains collision-free, but produces no meaningful full-face improvement.
Lowering the threshold to 1.38836 m adds six donor faces and creates a visible bright central strip.
A full additional ring reduces the dark aperture but introduces 32 neutral and 123 open-expression body intersections.
A second ring introduces both body penetration and donor-layer self-intersection.
decision: Retain r1106 as the active offline study and stop extending the neutral donor boundary.
nextAction: Create expression-specific upper-lip deformation and a restrained neutral aperture control while preserving the r1106 donor topology and 0.6 mm surface clearance.
